name: The Tutors Network (editorial placeholder)
summary: Representative enrichment / tutoring category entry — compare subject specialists carefully; Singapore’s arms race is optional in year one.
body: Singapore’s tuition culture is intense. Start from your child’s actual gaps, not neighbour panic. Ask for trial lessons, curriculum alignment (IB vs IGCSE vs MOE), and clear cancellation terms. Arrival-year guidance on expat.sg: one social and one physical activity before stacking weekday enrichment. Method centres (e.g. Kumon) and private tutors both fail when commute time exceeds learning gains — trial the specific teacher near home, not the brand brochure.
